assumptions: FDM PLA, 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.20 mm layers, at least two perimeters, and a 220 × 220 × 220 mm build volume.
Landmarks are original low-detail silhouette abstractions inspired by public architecture, not measured replicas or copies of plans, scans, façade art, logos, or commercial models.
Optional filament colours may aid presentation, but side and square identity remain geometric.

components.interfaces: Pieces rest freely on square centres; no constrained mate or fastener.

components.placement: Centred on XY with its print face upward and bed datum at Z=0.
components.purpose: Provides the orthodox 8 × 8 field and tactile square contrast without colour.

concept.intended_interaction: Place the 32 separately printed pieces on the 8 × 8 relief board and play unmodified orthodox chess; identify role by the monotonic 28–55 mm skyline and building silhouette, and identify side by the circular or square stepped base.
concept.signature_decision: Every chess role is an original upright-print abstraction of a different Ho Chi Minh City building, with supported projections intended for support-free slicing; round Saigon River plinths and square city-grid plinths distinguish the two armies without colour.
concept.summary: A compact orthodox chess set whose board relief, complete rank hierarchy, landmark silhouettes, and tactile side language make Ho Chi Minh City structural rather than decorative.
concept.title: Saigon Skyline Chess
unresolved_risks: No physical print has verified surface finish, handling comfort, toppling resistance, or durability.
No human playtest was run in this Spark effort; orthodox rules are preserved but customized-piece recognition has only digital inspection evidence.
No storage case is included; the 33 independent printed components need a separate padded container for transport.
Commercial release may require qualified review of modern-building reproduction and trademark issues; this is not a legal determination.

cad_evidence.checks: Static project layout; strict 220 mm bed fit; project-specific dimension/inventory audits; STEP refs, topology validation, positioning and combined interference; STL watertight/manifold/volume/bed checks; 0.8 mm minimum wall checks at a 0.4 mm nozzle for all 13 unique print targets.
